title: SM-09.09 - What is an inactive survey in EUSurvey
intent: This article answers: SM-09.09 - What is an inactive survey in EUSurvey
short_answer: A survey is considered inactive when it no longer receives new contributions. If a survey receives no new contributions for one year, or 365 days, it may be marked as inactive and become eligible for automatic deletion.
important_conditions: The inactivity trigger is based on new contributions.
The survey may become eligible for deletion after one year without new contributions.
